// diagnostic

E0204

Same value used while `mut` is active in one call

What

Same value used while `mut` is active in one call

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0204

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0204: tests/ui/borrow_conflict.stderr.

Error [E0204]: `x` is being changed in this call, so it can't be used again here
  --> tests/ui/borrow_conflict.jet:7:14
    |
  7 |     both(&x, x)
    |              ^
 Why: while something is being changed through the write-access marker `&`, nobody else may be looking at it
 Fix: pass the write-access marker `&` (`&x`) only once, or copy first with `~x`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0204
